title: Angels Landing permit lottery: 8% odds #Shorts
description:
Since 2022 you need a lottery permit to climb Angels Landing. Nearly 400,000 were issued in two years, and on the busiest days the odds of winning were as low as 8 percent.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #AngelsLanding #Zion #NationalParks
